project_info.theme: faithful professional restoration of an uploaded old family portrait
project_info.color_palette: source-faithful natural color with neutral whites and realistic skin tones

main_subject.type: people shown in the attached archival photograph
main_subject.detail: Use only the people, identity, age presentation, facial geometry, expression, clothing, pose, and relationship already visible in the attached source image.
main_subject.style: natural DSLR-quality restoration, not a reinterpretation or regeneration

composition_elements.text: Preserve only source text if present; do not add, alter, or invent writing.
items: match the original crop and composition
repair scratches, fading, stains, noise, and paper damage
retain authentic background, clothing, props, and historical context
preserve every person exactly as represented in the source

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: reconstruct plausible source-consistent lighting without changing direction or mood
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: balanced natural exposure, recovered shadow detail, restrained color restoration, no artificial glamour

technical_specs.render_style: high-resolution non-generative restoration comparable to a Canon EOS R6 Mark II portrait capture, precise face preservation, natural detail recovery, no smoothing
technical_specs.resolution: deliver at the source aspect ratio and highest recoverable detail

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Restore the attached old photograph into a professional DSLR-quality portrait with natural color and recovered detail. Preserve the exact facial features, identity, age presentation, expression, pose, clothing, background, crop, and relationships of every person in the source image. Repair scratches, fading, stains, noise, blur, and damaged areas conservatively. Improve clarity, tonal balance, and recoverable detail to a level comparable to a Canon EOS R6 Mark II portrait, but keep authentic skin texture, historical character, and the original photographic mood. Do not add people, remove people, alter faces, change clothing, invent details, or modernize the scene beyond faithful restoration.
prompt.negative_prompt: identity change, face swap, age alteration, added person, removed person, invented clothing, invented background, colorized artifacts, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text alteration, deformed, extra fingers

assets.name: source-archival-photo
assets.source: Attach the original old photograph to be restored.
assets.usage: This source is mandatory. Preserve all people and their exact visible identity, age presentation, pose, clothing, and relationships.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The original archival photo is mandatory. Do not replace its people or environment. Only restore recoverable technical quality: damage repair, exposure, color, detail, and noise. If a source region is too damaged to verify, preserve uncertainty rather than inventing content.
